main_issue: Whether and how Agent D can use the small room (closed door, ~15 min twice daily) given Agent B's need for unscheduled file access; A and C accept scheduling and notice, B refuses.

A-B.evidence: A accepts the notice-and-take-files plan (T32) and says the door must stay closed (T26); B says 'that doesn't work for me' (T33). B never addresses A directly.

A-C.evidence: A insists on a closed door (T26); C proposes the notice plan (T30) and A says 'That works for me too' (T32).

A-D.evidence: A and D negotiated times (T1-5), then A backed the notice plan D had suggested (T31-32). D had accepted 1 p.m. and offered alternative times.

B-C.evidence: C asks B how often (T28) and proposes the notice plan (T30); B rejects it (T33); C proposes moving the files out (T34).

B-D.evidence: D asks B about access and proposes notice (T10, T15); B says it doesn't work (T20, T33); D says then 'I can't use the room' (T21).

C-D.evidence: D shifted to 1:15 and C agreed (T8-9); D says of C's plan 'that's what I suggested' (T31).
